verdict.rationale: Data residency is a fair question for a SaaS remote-desktop service with accounts, team management and audit logs, so the axis applies. However, the evidence never documents a way to choose a storage region. The peer-to-peer claim and the Enterprise in-firewall relay describe how stream traffic is routed, not where stored data lives, so they are adjacent controls and earn no credit.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can choose where my data is stored (region/residency)
